verdict.rationale: Sentry's agent tracing is documented as capturing messages, tool calls, prompts, token usage and costs, but no evidence item mentions capturing images, audio, or file attachments in traces or spans. Multimodal payload capture is a fair question for an AI-tracing observability platform, so the absence of evidence makes this 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture multimodal payloads (images, audio, files) inside my traces
